Game Overview

At its heart, Mars Attack is a shooter game about stranded in haunting space, battle fierce creatures as you scavenge for survival. Strategize wisely with sparse ammo, upgrade weapons, and boost your health to endure the cosmic chaos. Will you conquer the unknown and triumph against Mars's terrifying challenges? Every decision shapes your fate.
